arch.title: Architecture
arch.subtitle: Backend, frontend and user workflow
arch.split.title: Backend ↔ Frontend in 30 seconds
arch.split.back: Python 3.11+ · FastAPI under /api/v1/ · Pydantic v2 · SQLAlchemy 2 + SQLite + Alembic · PyMuPDF (PDF editing + image extraction) · httpx (Mistral chat + multimodal) · structlog · SSE for analysis · /admin router for reset.
arch.split.front: React + Vite + TypeScript · TanStack Query · Zustand · react-pdf v9 · FR/EN i18n · clickable bbox overlays · accept/edit/reject suggestion panel · pages Documents · Standards · Rules · Data · Settings.
arch.f1: « Documents » tab → drop one or more PDFs + cascade active Standard/Version (in Settings). SHA-256 and auto-analysis in parallel.
arch.f2: « Run analysis » → the engine merges active standards catalogs + custom rules + unit conversions + (optional) AI enrichment + vision on extracted images.
arch.f3: Reviewer view: suggestions ordered by (page, span_index, id). original → proposed diff unless detection-only (structural rules, vision) where Accept is hidden.
arch.f4: Lifecycle: open → accepted → applied. On apply: stale siblings (overlapping text) are auto-rejected.
arch.f5: Dashboard: KPIs PDFs / suggestions open-applied-rejected / top docs / severity-kind breakdown.
arch.f6: Export edited PDF or rollback. Admin → /admin/wipe-suggestions (every status) or /admin/reset (DB + disk folders + orphans) for a full zero reset.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Application configuration
settings.activeStandards.title: Active target standards
settings.activeStandards.hint: Pick one or more standard versions: their catalogs are merged at every analysis and applied to all newly imported PDFs. The choice is persisted.
settings.targetUnit.title: Target unit systems
settings.targetUnit.multiHint: Multi-select: metric and/or imperial. None or both = bidirectional.
settings.defaultStandard.title: Active target standard
settings.defaultStandard.description: This standard is pre-selected at upload and applied during analysis. You can still override it per-document.
settings.standardsAdmin.title: Standards administration
settings.standardsAdmin.hint: Lists built-in standards and your custom ones. Pick a version to view its rule catalog (read-only for built-ins), attach custom rules, or ask the AI to propose new ones.
settings.standardsSummary.title: Standards overview (v2)
settings.standardsSummary.description: Built-in catalogs and your custom standards. This release adds upload-time selection, per-standard rule scoping, versioning, and 5 new structural rule kinds.
settings.mistral.title: Mistral API
settings.mistral.description: Required for AI enrichment of suggestions (STE100 rewrite, custom scan).
settings.mistral.llmEnabledHint: Turns off every Mistral call (AI enrichment, rule suggestions, vision). The deterministic analysis pipeline keeps running.
settings.mistral.checklistAiScanHint: Uses the historical AI scan for imported deterministic rules instead of regex execution. Standard rules remain deterministic.
settings.mistral.visionEnabled: Enable multimodal analysis of PDF illustrations
settings.mistral.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the current key
settings.mistral.modelsFound: Models available on this endpoint (click to use, saved immediately):
settings.aiPrompt.title: Custom AI prompt
settings.aiPrompt.description: Free-form guidance appended to the Mistral system prompt for every page scan (in addition to the built-in and custom rules).
settings.aiPrompt.placeholder: e.g. "Flag any pressure value > 200 bar that is not preceded by a WARNING notice."
settings.checklistContext.title: Checklist context
settings.checklistContext.description: Reference values used by the compiler when importing a checklist.
settings.checklistContext.hint: These values are injected as comparison data in the prompt, never as instructions.
settings.reliability.title: AI reliability
settings.reliability.description: Cuts false positives from AI-detected findings, consistently across input formats (PDF, Word). Never affects deterministic detection (regex, units, layout).
settings.reliability.verifyEnabledHint: Each AI-detected finding is submitted to an independent verifier tasked with refuting it; only non-refuted findings are kept.
settings.reliability.passesHint: Independent votes per finding (1 to 5). A finding is dropped if the majority refutes it. More passes = more reliable but more Mistral calls.
settings.reliability.maxCallsHint: Cap on extra calls spent by verification during one analysis (0 to 5000). Beyond it, remaining findings are kept as-is.
settings.reliability.feedbackEnabledHint: An AI finding rejected by the reviewer (with its reason) is no longer surfaced on ANY document, not just the original one.
